value.rationale: The motivated question is how conditioning a canonical random inscribed triangle to be acute changes its entire shape distribution, not a single scalar moment. The result discovers an exact, inverse-explicit affine coupling identified with a classical geometric excentral operation. It gives simultaneous pathwise ordering for all symmetric Schur-concave functionals, strict stochastic improvements for three distinct geometric shape quantities and an exact full-law factor-four angular-variance contraction. These properties furnish a rejection-free conditional sampler and a general structure theorem not captured by the previously known 1/4 probability or known area-moment tables.
